intended_population: Previously untreated primary or resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma represented by bulk tumor transcriptomes.
intended_output: A continuous, composition-invariant transcriptomic relative-risk score. Batch-relative z scores, percentiles and tertiles are secondary outputs available only when at least 40 samples are scored together.
not_intended_for: absolute survival probability or individual survival-time prediction
clinical diagnosis, prognosis, treatment selection or medical-device use
use as a fixed clinical high/low threshold

algorithm.name: MarginRank-DG
algorithm.description: Continuous within-sample ranks are centered on the median rank of six locked anchor genes. Forty locked gene margins are passed to a pooled ridge Cox model selected by balanced leave-one-domain-out evaluation.

independent_validation.interpretation: The frozen model passed the prespecified independent external gate, but superiority over the frozen v2 predecessor was not statistically secure.

stress_tests.endpoint: short (<10 months) versus long (>20 months) survival
stress_tests.interpretation: Directionally supportive but underpowered and not statistically significant.
Strong direction reversal; this is a boundary failure and excludes treated metastatic PDAC from intended use.

biological_context.ranked_context: Adverse cross-domain genes emphasized cell-cycle and DNA-synthesis programs; favorable genes emphasized oxidative and pancreatic metabolic programs. These results are contextual and do not establish mechanism or causality.

known_limitations: Retrospective public cohorts and heterogeneous treatment annotation.
No prospective clinical validation and no wet-laboratory validation.
Independent discrimination is moderate rather than diagnostic-grade.
Absolute calibration was not transportable and was deliberately removed.
The raw score is sample-composition invariant, while percentiles and tertiles are cohort relative.
Low reference coverage changes the empirical rank scale and invalidates confirmatory interpretation.
